data.subject: accounting close at Zipline
data.body:
Hi Mac,

Zipline is hiring an accounting intern to prepare journal entries and reconcile accounts. Having led GTM finance at Zipline before your current role, hiring support for reconciliations usually indicates manual close tasks are accumulating. Block removed 75% of human touchpoints in the accounting close.

Are you open to a 20-minute call to see how Zamp handles these workflows end to end?

[Your name]
